ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity dark pixels, with dark pigmentation primarily confined to the perimeter and central peduncle region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark border along the trailing edge and tips; a distinct, horizontally-oriented dark elliptical blob is located in the lower-central region near the waterline; scattered dark focal spots are visible on the mid-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a narrow vertex angle and a depth of approximately 15% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Relatively low-amplitude serration along the mid-lobe trailing edges, transitioning to high-amplitude, irregular peaks (pixel clusters) at the distal tips caused by biological encrustation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave sweep from the median notch to the tips, creating a 'recurved' geometry along the trailing edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, jagged pixel clusters at the far-left and far-right tips corresponding to barnacle colonies; small circular dark spots on the lower-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal tips, significantly altering the edge profile compared to a smooth geometric curve.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, isolated horizontal dark pigmentation mark centered just above the peduncle connection.
